title: The sl(2) weight system at c = -3/32 extends to a graph 4-invariant â€” submission package
description:
The sl(2) weight system at c = -3/32 extends to a graph 4-invariant. Hexagon/Overleaf and European Journal of Combinatorics submission preparation, version 2.2.0. The reviewed folder Paper_7 package contains the article PDF, a minimal compilable TeX ZIP, AI provenance, Hexagon fields, journal details, an unsent cover letter with editable source, and an author-prepared AI disclosure. All PDFs have no row or margin line numbers. No journal submission or acceptance is claimed.

The paper proves Conjecture 4.1 of Fomichev, Karev, Pavutnitskiy and Usanov: the sl(2) weight system at c=-3/32 extends to a graph four-invariant. The explicit signed-count construction works on every finite graph and agrees with the matrix-defined weight system on every chord diagram. This revision adds a normal-form proof and clarifies verification scope.

Verification scope: The universal extension theorem and its matrix-trace definition are formalized in Lean 4.34.1 with pinned Mathlib. At the unchanged proof-source commit, the complete build and four endpoint axiom reports passed with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Python exact checks were rerun locally; Julia, C and C++ passed in the archived full run. The grouping proof for part (a) and the added faithful-action lemma are supplied in the written argument; no new formalization of the abstract Weyl algebra is claimed.

Original preprint: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00320v1. Earlier manuscript/source DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23541142. Original attribution and component licences are preserved. Human-understanding and mixed-text fields retain the existing Paper 7 preprint declarations unless the author updates them. The standalone AI declaration is author-prepared, not an official signed publisher form.
